scope: Actual Kotlin analysis/stockTEXTURE and scratch independent-clockPSOLA generation; FFmpegEBUR128 matching; independent Python signal measurements. Owner listening pending. No app/bank/CI change.

hostCost.scope: Actual calls on this Java 17 JVM, 1 CPU: six clips plus a private formant-scale ablation. Not phone latency. FFmpeg measurement excluded.

conditions.matching: Constant gain to −22 LUFS integrated by FFmpeg EBU R128 over the common 3-second window. Components matched first, then complete clips; no compressor/limiter. This is measured loudness matching, not a claim of identical perceived loudness.

pitch.method: Python/SciPy broad YIN 70–600 Hz, full 46.44 ms windows / 9.98 ms hop, central 0.50–1.85 s. No target/reference note enters selection. Pair pitch is not estimated.

spectral.method: Welch 4096 / 50 percent overlap on 0.60–1.80 s; log-power real-cepstrum raised-cosine lifter up to 1 ms removes fine harmonic structure, then gain-normalized envelope comparison 300–5000 Hz. Not a perceptual identity score.
spectral.formantAblationOnlyDifference: Scale 1.08 versus 1.00; same input epochs, output F0 curve, duration, envelope; each level-matched independently.

clips.title: A alone
clips.description: One actual recorded singer: VocalSet male3, straight /a/, native pitch.
processing: Raw source A retained separately. Mean removal and declared 60 ms entrance / 140 ms release shape this finite body crop; native pitch is retained.
Every staged body has its DC mean removed before its finite envelope. Dry mono, common 3-second window. Final EBU R128 matching uses constantgain only; raw source crops remain separately available.

clips.title: A + B · recorded reference
clips.description: Two independent singers recorded separately, summed in mono; neither source is pitch-corrected.
processing: A enters at 0.200 s; actual independent B enters at 0.245 s. Both recordings retain native pitch, with about 30.25 cents median separation.
Components are first matched independently to −22 LUFS, then summed at equal-power gains; one final scalar sets the complete clip to −22 LUFS.
Every staged body has its DC mean removed before its finite envelope. Dry mono, common 3-second window. Final EBU R128 matching uses constantgain only; raw source crops remain separately available.

clips.title: Generated from A · alone
clips.description: A transformed with a vocal-color change and its own pitch movement. It is generated from A.
processing: Scratch extension, not unchanged production renderer: source A epochs/periods control input grains; an independent output pulse clock is centered at B’s measured native median.
Fixed formant/pulse-color scale 1.08; source chronology ratio 0.992. Independent target cents(t)=8.5(1−exp(−6max(0,t−.12)))sin(2π(5.23t+.31))+3.5sin(2π(.61t+.07))+2sin(2π(1.37t+.62)).
Enters at 0.245 s,90 ms entrance / 180 ms release. No generated breath or new articulation; this is a held-vowel body.
Every staged body has its DC mean removed before its finite envelope. Dry mono, common 3-second window. Final EBU R128 matching uses constantgain only; raw source crops remain separately available.

clips.title: A + generated voice
clips.description: Recorded A plus the same generated-from-A candidate heard in the preceding row. Not a new human recording.
processing: Exactly the same A and generated component stems used for their solo rows, combined after independent component-level matching.
One final constant scalar matches the complete pair to −22 LUFS. No room, stereo placement, harmony, compressor or limiter.
Every staged body has its DC mean removed before its finite envelope. Dry mono, common 3-second window. Final EBU R128 matching uses constantgain only; raw source crops remain separately available.

risks: Generated voice is transformed A, not a new real human or a learned copy ofB.
Short stable vowel bodies do not establish quality on words, consonants or full cultural gestures.
Local pulse dilation is a bounded formant-color hypothesis; it is not a vocal tract model or verified biological identity change.
Independent output clock and spectral changes are numeric properties; they do not prove the owner hears two people.
Both crops end inside a held vowel. The disclosed audition envelopes create finite releases; no new breath is generated.
No room/stereo/harmony or full gesture automaticF0 processing is used.
whyBuiltThisWay: Actual independent B establishes the recorded positive reference before evaluating a synthetic identity.
Dry mono and constant gain matching remove room/width/loudness as alternative explanations.
The separate output clock avoids carrying A native pitch motion into every synthetic part.
Raw sourcecrops and complete processing recipes remain inspectable; no source preparation is hidden.
